description: Expand the store internationally by creating a new Store Group named 'NestWell Europe' under the Main Website. Then, create two new Store Views inside this group: 'French Store View' (code: nestwell_fr) and 'German Store View' (code: nestwell_de). Finally, configure the locale for the French view to 'French (France)' and the German view to 'German (Germany)', and add 'Euro' to the allowed currencies for the Main Website. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
